text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp begins today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa and I will be fully
immersed in
training as we spend the
coming days at the
academy's
specialized camping facility.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Soon after arriving, I toss my luggage in
my room
and head to the beach with
her.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Okay. What are we doing today?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. Let's make the most of this
place.
choice_data_list: For now, I guess it's building stamina.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...You've been keeping in touch with her
too,
huh? Not that I'm really surprised.
choice_data_list: Speaking of which, about the teacher...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Until recently, whenever I messaged her,
she'd
always reply the same day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, her response time has been
gradually
getting longer—sometimes the
next day, three
days later, or even a
week.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Her messages have gotten shorter, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe her condition is making it harder
for her to
reply. I don't like the
implications...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: Still, I'm sure they're watching your races.
Still, I'm sure they're watching your races.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Try not to strain those face muscles with
that
awkward smile. Cheering people up
really isn't
your thing.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wooow, it's El! ♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass! It's summer camp time again!
Another year,
and plenty more bulk!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa is surrounded by a crowd
of
Umamusume. Standing next to her is
Grass
Wonder, another runner of the
Golden
Generation.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you already considered a
world-class
runner?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What are you doing still in Japan?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, El Condor Pasa! Could we get a few
words?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear that the winner of the
Japanese
Oaks is going to take on the
Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe?! Do you have
anything to say to her?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I will say nada! Now, if you'll allow me
some
space, I need to make my escape
before
everyone gets all chaotic and
noisy!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El, I had something to discuss too...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass! I've been searching all this time
for a rough
gem to follow in my
footsteps!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And, during this year's Classics, a shining
light has
caught my eye!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! El Condor Pasa! Sigh... I was really hoping to snap a photo of her...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
But did you hear her? She said there's a
rough
gem following her footsteps that
is currently
running in the Classics. It has
to be
you-know-who!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Guess the media couldn't give a damn
about me
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'm still going all in. The bet is still on.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'll get them to notice me again. Come
on, let's
get started.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, summer camp with Nakayama
Festa
begins!
